@@U03931@@
Never let loose of this dress! Never! Demons already are plucking away at its edges, eager to drag it off to the underworld. Hold fast to it, I say! This may no longer be the goddess you've lost, but it is divine. Make the most of this favor beyond all price and raise yourself up with it. It will bear you swiftly above all things common into vast Spaces as long as you survive. We'll meet again, we two, far, very far from here. (海伦’: clothes dissolve into clouds, surround 浮士德, bear him aloft, and move off with him. 福耳库阿斯 picks up 欧福里翁 5 robe, cloak, and lyre and advances into the proscenium, holds them up, and speaks.)

@@U03933@@
No mean find, these, no matter what. The flame may have disappeared, but it won't be the death of poetry, you'll see. With these I can always get things started, don't you know, get the poetic juices flowing, stir up a little jealousy among professionals. And though I may not have talent to lend, at least I have the costume to be lent.

@@U03934@@
(She sits down in the proscenium at the foot of a column.)

@@U03936@@
Move along there, girls! Quick, now! We're rid at last of that witch’s befuddling Thessalian magic! No more jingle-jangle of her tinkling tunes that so confuse the ears
translation:
@@U03931@@
永远不要松开这件衣服！绝不！恶魔们已经开始撕扯它的边缘，渴望将它拖入地下世界。我说，坚持住！这可能不再是你失去的女神，但它是神圣的。充分利用这份不计代价的恩惠，并以此提升自己。只要你还活着，它就会带着你飞快地飞过所有常见的东西进入广阔的空间。我们两个，会再次见面的，距离这里很远很远。 （海伦’：衣裳化作云，围住浮士德，高高举起，随行。福耳库阿斯，拿起欧福里翁五袍、斗篷、琴，上台上，举起而行。）

@@U03933@@
无论如何，找到这些都不是一件容易的事。火焰可能已经消失，但这不会是诗歌的死亡，你会看到的。有了这些，我总能开始工作，你知道吗，让诗意的果汁流动，在专业人士中激起一点嫉妒。虽然我可能没有才华可以借，但至少我有服装可以借。

@@U03934@@
（她坐在柱子脚下的台口上。）

@@U03936@@
往那里走吧，女孩们！快点，现在！我们终于摆脱了那个女巫令人迷惑的色萨利魔法！不再有叮叮当当的叮叮当当的曲调让耳朵感到困惑
